name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 证据扛不动的话，一个字都不许写
tagline_zh: 写结论前先过一道「主张阶梯」：观察→方向→决策，因果没设计就闭嘴。自动揪出夸大措辞，逼你报效应量。
tagline_en: Before you publish any conclusion, run it through the claim ladder: observed→directional→decision-support. No.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是改文风，是卡证据链：每个结论必须匹配数据能撑住的层级，越级直接拦下。
why_en: It's not a style guide—it's an evidence gate. Every claim must match the data's strength; anything stronger gets blocked.
limit_zh: 只处理分析结果的文字表述，不碰图表生成；需要你提供原始结论或草稿；对非因果表述的审查依赖你标注研究设计。
limit_en: Text-only for analysis write-ups; needs your draft or conclusion; relies on your design annotation—unannotated claims default to observed-level.
title_en: Write only what your evidence can carry
